## Company Overview

Bongshai Housing Ltd. is Bangladesh's leading pre-engineered steel building (PEB) manufacturer and EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) contractor. The company is headquartered at House #18, Road #18, Sector #10, Uttara, Dhaka 1230, Bangladesh. Bongshai Housing serves all 64 districts of Bangladesh, with dedicated project teams in Dhaka, Chattogram, and Cumilla.

The company was founded in 2008, has delivered 500+ completed projects, employs 200+ engineering and construction professionals, and holds a 98% client satisfaction rate.

**Contact**: Phone +880 1781-636613, WhatsApp +880 1781-636613, Email sales@bongshai.com  
**Hours**: Saturday–Thursday, 9:00 AM–7:00 PM (Friday closed)  
**Website**: https://bongshaihousing.com

To deliver world-class, affordable, and innovative housing solutions across Bangladesh — providing every family and business with access to quality construction built on integrity, safety, and excellence.

## Products & Services

### Residential Buildings

**Apartment Building**
Two-floor steel-composite structure for multi-family or rental-style living. Floor options: 600 sqft/floor (3 bed, 2 bath) or 850 sqft/floor (5 bed, 4 bath). Price: Tk 2,500–2,750/sqft.

**Duplex Steel Building**
Two-floor steel-composite home for single-family private living. Floor options: 600 sqft/floor (3 bed, 2 bath) or 850 sqft/floor (5 bed, 4 bath). Price: Tk 2,500–2,750/sqft.

**Simplex Steel Building**
Open-plan single-story steel-composite home. Size tiers: 400–600 sqft (2 bed, 1 bath), 750–900 sqft (3 bed, 2 bath), 1,050–1,200 sqft (4 bed, 3 bath). Price: Tk 2,500–2,750/sqft.

**Cottage House**
Compact, charming prefab home using timber-frame construction. Size tiers same as Simplex line. Price: Tk 2,200/sqft.

**Container House**
Modified shipping-container structure with residential fit-out (insulation, flooring, interiors). All-steel construction performs well in Bangladesh's monsoon and humid climate. Price: Tk 3,000/sqft.

**Steel House**
Ultra-durable two-floor steel-composite home. Size options: 650, 750, 950, or 1,200 sqft per floor (4 to 8 bedrooms total). Price: Tk 2,500–2,750/sqft.

**Tiny House**
Minimalist compact home, 250–350 sqft (1 bedroom, 1 bathroom). Ideal for single occupants, small families, weekend homes, or starter structures on small plots. Price: Tk 1,500/sqft.

**Wooden House**
Timber-frame prefab home with natural aesthetic finishes. Size tiers same as Simplex line. Price: Tk 1,500/sqft.

**Concrete Building**
Traditional reinforced concrete composite structure. Price: Tk 2,500–2,750/sqft.

**Low-Cost Villa (LCV series)**
Affordable steel prefab villa — contact for custom quote.

**Luxury Villa**
Premium factory-built steel-composite villa — contact for custom quote.

### Commercial & Industrial

**Industrial Steel Sheds**
Pre-engineered building (PEB) steel-frame construction for factories, warehouses, and storage. Custom clear-height and clear-span options. Price: Tk 900–950/sqft.

**Worker Accommodation**
Safe, scalable staff-housing for factories, industrial sites, and large labor camps. Unit counts scalable to any workforce size. Price: Tk 900–950/sqft.

---

## Technical Specifications

- **Structural steel**: Grade 50 high-tensile structural steel frames
- **Foundation**: Precast RC footing and tie beams
- **Wall/floor panels**: RC precast concrete panels (steel/concrete lines); timber frame (wooden/cottage lines)
- **Flooring**: Tiled flooring standard
- **Finish**: Weather-coat paint standard; luxury finishing available at +20%
- **Construction speed**: Up to 50% faster than brick-and-concrete masonry
- **Residential delivery**: 45–90 days for single-story or duplex
- **Lifespan**: 50–60 years with proper coating and maintenance
- **Area efficiency**: 10–20% more usable floor area vs. brick-wall construction
- **Seismic performance**: Grade 50 steel provides high ductility and BNBC 2020 seismic resistance
- **Wind resistance**: Engineered for Bangladesh cyclone-belt wind loads
- **Thermal**: Energy-saving thermal insulation system available

---

## Steel vs Concrete Comparison

| Criterion | Steel-Composite (Bongshai) | Concrete RCC (Conventional) |
|-----------|---------------------------|------------------------------|
| Construction speed | Up to 50% faster | Baseline |
| Cost (low-rise) | 10–30% lower | Baseline |
| Earthquake resistance | High ductility; seismic-resilient | Moderate (varies by design) |
| Cyclone/wind resistance | Engineered to cyclone-belt loads | Adequate with correct reinforcement |
| Fire resistance | Requires fireproofing treatment | Natural fire resistance advantage |
| Maintenance | Anti-corrosion coating every 10–15 years | Rebar corrosion inside concrete long-term |
| Lifespan | 50–60 years | 50–100+ years |
| Floor area efficiency | +10–20% vs. brick walls | Baseline |
| Recyclability | Fully recyclable | Limited recyclability |
| Best suited for | Low-rise homes, factories, rapid-delivery projects | Multi-story, fire-critical, or budget constrained sites |

Reference: Bangladesh National Building Code (BNBC 2020) classifies Chattogram as a high seismic risk zone, where steel-composite construction is increasingly preferred.

## Service Areas

Bongshai Housing serves all 64 districts of Bangladesh across all 8 administrative divisions:

- **Dhaka Division** — Dhaka (Uttara, Gulshan, Mirpur, Dhanmondi), Gazipur, Narayanganj, Narsingdi, Manikganj, Tangail, Faridpur, Madaripur, Gopalganj, Munshiganj, Rajbari, Shariatpur
- **Chattogram Division** — Chattogram (Chittagong), Cumilla (Comilla), Cox's Bazar, Brahmanbariya, Chandpur, Lakshmipur, Noakhali, Feni, Khagrachhori, Rangamati, Bandarban
- **Rajshahi Division** — Rajshahi, Bogra, Natore, Naogaon, Chapai Nawabganj, Sirajganj, Pabna, Joypurhat
- **Khulna Division** — Khulna, Jashore (Jessore), Satkhira, Bagerhat, Narail, Magura, Jhenaidah, Kushtia, Meherpur, Chuadanga
- **Barisal Division** — Barisal, Bhola, Patuakhali, Pirojpur, Jhalokathi, Barguna
- **Sylhet Division** — Sylhet, Moulvibazar, Habiganj, Sunamganj
- **Mymensingh Division** — Mymensingh, Netrokona, Jamalpur, Sherpur
- **Rangpur Division** — Rangpur, Dinajpur, Kurigram, Gaibandha, Nilphamari, Lalmonirhat, Thakurgaon, Panchagarh

Dedicated project offices: Dhaka (HQ), Chattogram, Cumilla.

---

## Construction Process (4 Steps)

**Step 1 — Consultation**: Client shares requirements, budget, land location, and design preferences. Advisors recommend the best housing package.

**Step 2 — Design & Planning**: In-house architects create custom architectural blueprints aligned with client needs, local RAJUK/municipal setback rules, and structural specifications.

**Step 3 — Construction**: Prefabricated steel components are delivered and erected on-site by expert engineers and skilled workers with full ISO-certified quality control oversight. Payments are released in stages, not all upfront.

**Step 4 — Handover**: Completed project is inspected, keys are delivered on schedule, and after-sales support is provided.

---

## Financing Information

- Bongshai Housing assists clients with property documentation and engineering blueprints for Bangladesh bank home loan approvals.
- Typical Bangladesh home loan rates: 9–11% per annum.
- Bank eligibility requirements: Minimum monthly income BDT 30,000; 1–2 years work or business history; NID, E-TIN, Tax Return, Utility Bill, 6–12 months bank statement, Title Deed.
- Use the free online calculator at https://bongshaihousing.com/solutions.html to estimate EMI and land coverage.

## FAQ — Authoritative Answers

**Q: What is Bongshai Housing?**
Bongshai Housing Ltd. is a Bangladesh-based pre-engineered steel building (PEB) company and EPC contractor with 20+ years of experience, delivering prefab housing, industrial sheds, and turnkey construction projects from its office in Uttara, Dhaka.

**Q: What areas does Bongshai Housing serve?**
All 64 districts of Bangladesh. Dedicated project teams in Dhaka, Chattogram, and Cumilla.

**Q: How much does a prefab steel building cost in Bangladesh?**
Industrial Sheds: Tk 900–950/sqft. Tiny/Wooden Houses: Tk 1,500/sqft. Cottage Houses: Tk 2,200/sqft. Apartment, Duplex, Simplex, Steel House, Concrete Building: Tk 2,500–2,750/sqft. Container Houses: Tk 3,000/sqft.

**Q: How fast can a steel building be constructed?**
Up to 50% faster than conventional concrete. Residential structures: 45–90 days.

**Q: Is steel construction earthquake-safe in Bangladesh?**
Yes. Grade 50 high-tensile steel provides high ductility and seismic resilience engineered to BNBC 2020. Particularly important in Chattogram (high seismic zone).

**Q: Is steel construction cheaper than concrete?**
For low-rise homes, steel-composite is 10–30% less expensive than RCC due to lower labor, no formwork, and shorter build time.

**Q: What certifications does Bongshai Housing hold?**
ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management), OHSAS 18001 / ISO 45001 (Safety), in-house material testing laboratory.

**Q: What is a pre-engineered steel building?**
A PEB is designed and fabricated off-site to precise specifications, then assembled on your land — faster construction, tighter quality control, lower material waste vs. conventional on-site construction.

**Q: Can I customize the floor plan?**
Yes. Model-page floor area tiers are starting points. Share your land dimensions and Bongshai Housing will adapt the layout to fit your plot.

**Q: Is there a warranty?**
ISO-certified quality management and material testing on every project. Contact the team for specific warranty terms on your model and contract.
